rules.text: Employees are entitled to 18 paid leave days per year.
Leave requests of 1-2 days do not require manager approval and are auto-approved if sufficient balance exists.
Leave requests of 3 or more consecutive days require manager approval, regardless of balance.
Leave cannot be approved if it exceeds the employee's remaining balance.
Leave requests must specify a clear start date and number of days; ambiguous requests should be flagged for clarification.
